offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers in Texas, Florida, Georgia, the Carolinas and other Sunbelt markets. It also develops residential lots and land, and arranges mortgage financing for its buyers through its own subsidiaries.

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time, move-up and retirement homebuyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: home sales to individual buyers at closing; other: lot and land sales to other builders

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds homes from purchased land, materials and subcontracted trades, sold to homebuyers; other: develops raw land into finished lots, sold to homebuilders and buyers

geography_served.value: US regional: Texas, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee and other Sunbelt states

specialization.value: related lines: single-family homes, townhomes, lot development and mortgage financing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams at community sales offices; own locations: model homes and sales centers in its communities; agents / brokers: independent real estate agents bringing buyers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, environmental and land-use rules, consumer protection and mortgage lending rules

notes: Business mix, brand names and state footprint are from general knowledge and may have changed; mortgage and land operations are less certain.
